family.description: This entry represents Surface attachment protein BP1026B_II1992. This protein is required for infection of the mammalian host cells and complete B.pseudomallei pathogenesis in vivo. Attaches to host cells [[cite:PUB00159059]]. This entry includes Surface attachment protein BPSS1860 which is required for infection of the mammalian host cells and complete B.pseudomallei pathogenesis in vivo.
